title: A Phone Call Checking on a Sick Friend
script: Sami: [caring] Hey, I heard you weren't feeling well. How are you doing today?
Rania: [tired] Hi Sami. Honestly, not great. I've had a fever since yesterday morning.
Sami: [concerned] That sounds rough. Have you seen a doctor, or are you just resting at home?
Rania: [weak] I called a clinic this morning. They said it's probably just a virus, nothing serious.
Sami: [relieved] That's good to hear, at least. Are you drinking enough water?
Rania: [honest] Not as much as I should, honestly. I don't feel like drinking or eating much at all.
Sami: [caring] Try small sips throughout the day, even if you're not thirsty. Your body needs it to fight the fever.
Rania: [tired] You're right. I'll try to drink more water after we hang up.
Sami: [gently] Do you have anyone bringing you food, or are you completely alone right now?
Rania: [honest] My neighbor checked on me this morning, but otherwise I'm alone in the apartment.
Sami: [determined] I'm coming by this evening with some soup, then. No arguments allowed.
Rania: [touched] You don't have to do that, Sami, but honestly, thank you so much.
Sami: [warmly] Of course I do. That's what friends are for, especially when someone is sick alone.
Rania: [tired] I keep telling myself I'll feel better tomorrow, but today has been really hard.
Sami: [gently] It's okay to have a hard day. Just rest, and let your body do its work.
Rania: [honest] I've been trying to sleep, but the fever keeps waking me up every couple of hours.
Sami: [caring] Do you have any medicine for the fever, or something cool for your forehead?
Rania: [thoughtful] I have some medicine, actually. I just haven't taken it today.
Sami: [encouraging] Take it now, while we're talking. I'll stay on the phone if you need to.
Rania: [grateful] Okay, give me one second. Thank you for pushing me to actually take care of myself.
Sami: [warmly] That's exactly what I'm here for. I'll see you this evening with soup and company.
Rania: [relieved] I really appreciate you calling. It already makes me feel a little less alone.
Sami: [gently] Rest now, drink some water, and I'll knock on your door around six. Feel better soon.
Rania: [warmly] Thank you, Sami. I'll see you this evening.
